prompt:
Shorten the following notes to at most 200 words, keeping the most useful facts. Reply with the shortened notes only.

Notes for future self (matmul, n≈1000, gcc, OpenMP, AVX-512 machine):

- Baseline: a 6×16 ymm BLIS-style kernel with packed A and B ran at 7.1 ms (Attempt 0).
- Biggest structural win: stop packing A and read A rows directly with stride n. This brought 7.1 to 6.6 ms. Global A pre-pack and per-task A repacking both hurt (8.3 and 9.2 ms).
- KCMAX: 384 helped slightly over 320 (6.5 ms). 512 was a disaster at 10.3 ms because the B panel overflowed L1. KC=192 with an 8×32 zmm kernel gave no gain.
- AVX-512 only paid off with a 12×32 zmm kernel: 24 accumulators, A rows unpacked, a zero-padded ebuf for the row edge, and an NV=1 path for column edges. That gave 6.1 ms.
- Putting the `ir` loop outside and `jp` inside, so A rows stay in L1, gave 5.9 ms, the current best (Attempt 10).
- No help or harmful: `-mno-avx512f`, the 16× manual unroll with prefetches, `-funroll-loops` combined with a big body, and masked edge stores (neutral).
- Next things to try, one at a time:
  - KCMAX of about 192–224 with 12×32, trading the B panel fitting in L1 against an extra C pass.
  - Pack B per kb slice to remove the serial pre-pack barrier.
  - An 8-column masked edge.
  - Tuning MC and PPCMAX.
  - Packing the 12-row A strip contiguously per (task, kb), in case n=1024 aliasing matters.

Notes (matmul, n≈1000, gcc, OpenMP, AVX-512):

- Baseline (Attempt 0): 6×16 ymm BLIS kernel, packed A and B, 7.1 ms.
- Unpacked A (read rows with stride n): 6.6 ms. Global A pre-pack (8.3) and per-task A repack (9.2) both hurt.
- KCMAX 384 slightly beat 320 (6.5 ms). 512 gave 10.3 ms because the B panel overflowed L1. KC=192 with 8×32 zmm gave no gain.
- AVX-512 only helped with a 12×32 zmm kernel: 24 accumulators, unpacked A, zero-padded ebuf for the row edge, NV=1 path for column edges. 6.1 ms.
- Best so far (Attempt 10), 5.9 ms: `ir` loop outer, `jp` inner, so A rows stay in L1.
- Neutral or harmful: `-mno-avx512f`, 16× manual unroll with prefetches, `-funroll-loops` with a big body, masked edge stores (neutral).
- Try next, one at a time:
  - KCMAX ~192–224 with 12×32 (B panel fits L1 vs. extra C pass).
  - Pack B per kb slice to drop the serial pre-pack barrier.
  - 8-column masked edge.
  - Tune MC and PPCMAX.
  - Pack the 12-row A strip contiguously per (task, kb), in case n=1024 aliasing matters.
